item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President explains his present withholding of approval from S. 1128 in a veto communication; this is not presidential governance over agencies or legal rights under the codebook.","evidence":"For these reasons, I cannot approve S. 1128."},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The administration expresses a future intention to work with Congress on legislation; it neither directs an agency nor itself changes any legal consequence.","evidence":"My administration will work closely with the next Congress to pass acceptable legislation."}]}
